As in the world of products, the frequency of the consumer's need differentiates the quality of the competitive advantage.

points.title: Can the company repurchase shares to investors' advantage?
points.question: A good sign that a company has a DCA is that it will have a long history of buying back its shares. If they are building cars or designing software, they may not have to buy big expensive jets, or can use the same equipment for twenty years without any risk of obsolescence. If the answer is yes, be careful.

If the treasuries look juicier, the stock might be overpriced.

points.title: Projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond (Book Value model)
points.question: What is the company's projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond? Take the company's average per share return on equity for the last ten years and subtract the average percentage that is not retained and is paid out as a dividend. Use the resulting difference as the rate of growth that the company's book value will grow.
